title: About me
text:
I’m a postdoctoral researcher at the Bioinformatics Research Center at North Carolina State University, where I study viral, bacterial and plasmid communities in environmental metagenomes. I’m interested in how microbes adapt to a changing climate, and in finding solutions that improve outcomes for people and the planet.
I care about open science, reproducibility and FAIR data: good science should be usable and verifiable by others, not just publishable. As a Nextflow Ambassador (2026), I lead workshops and write training materials that take graduate students and professionals from zero to running their own pipelines.
Download my CV

title: About me
text:
Research interests


Viruses and plasmids in the environment
Viral and mobile genetic element discovery in soil, wastewater and gut metagenomes, and what these elements tell us about how microbial communities respond to disturbance.


Reproducible, benchmarked pipelines
Nextflow pipelines that benchmark machine-learning viral inference tools against simulated communities with known ground truth, to find out where they fail.


Open science and training
Bioinformatics curricula, from HPC and Bash to metagenomics and Nextflow, built to make computational biology accessible to non-specialists.

title: About me
text:
Experience

Sep 2025 – present
Postdoctoral Researcher · Bioinformatics Research Center, NC State University · Raleigh, NC

Building a reproducible Nextflow pipeline to benchmark ML-based viral inference tools (geNomad, VirSorter2, DeepVirFinder) against simulated communities
Designing lab-wide computational infrastructure, including Nextflow pipeline logic and a structured data lake for multi-omics workflows
Leading viral and plasmid analysis of European wastewater samples, and of the bee gut microbiome in a passage experiment on microbial drift
Developing and teaching bioinformatics curricula (HPC, Unix/Bash, metagenomics, RNA-Seq, Nextflow) at NC State and University College Dublin
Deploying nf-core pipelines as self-service Open OnDemand apps on the institutional HPC via nf2ood



Jan 2020 – May 2025
Graduate Assistant · Barberán Lab, University of Arizona · Tucson, AZ

Led viral and plasmid metagenomic analysis of soil samples on university HPC
Designed bioinformatics pipelines for soil and environmental metagenomics
Led field soil sampling and DNA extraction for viral and microbial community studies
Instructor of record and teaching assistant for undergraduate data analysis and environmental science courses



Feb 2019 – May 2019
Junior Programmer · Sopra Steria · Madrid, Spain

Back-end application programming



Jun 2017 – Mar 2018
Graduate Assistant · Technical University of Denmark (DTU) · Copenhagen, Denmark

Curated microbial tool metadata for ELIXIR bio.tools, and supported nitritation-anammox wastewater bioreactor research at DTU Environment
